'''Bardo Klinj''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who lived on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Borvo has a -- reputation, and the authorities tend to keep an eye on his known associates.|Bardo Klinj, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BK" />}}
Bardo Klinj was a criminal who worked for [[Borvo]] [[Hutt/Legends|the Hutt]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] based on Naboo. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of Borvo in the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]]. During this time, Klinj had to deal with [[Kritus Morven's gang]],<ref name="SWG:BK" /> a rival criminal group very active in Keren.<ref name="SWG:KM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Kritus Morven|Naboo}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Bardo Klinj employed a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to help him with several tasks. Bardo first tasked the spacer with delivering an unmarked package containing [[Kassoti]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Courier/Legends|courier]] in order to corrupt an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]]. Thereafter, the adventurer had to meet another Imperial courier, [[Val Tula]], to receive a "gift" for Borvo from a grateful Imperial official, namely Imperial export permits. Although the spacer was attacked by Kritus Morven's henchmen, the individual carried out the tasks successfully, and was awarded 250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from Klinj. Some time later, Bardo Klinj was concerned about a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] named [[Mubarr]] who refused to reimburse the money he owned to Borvo the Hutt. Bardo's [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] had sliced Mubarr's bank records and had discovered that the Gungan had enough money to pay. Bardo therefore requested the spacer to enforce Mubarr to give the codes of his bank account.<ref name="SWG:BK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bardo Klinj was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Bardo Klinj could be found in the city of Keren on Naboo,<ref name="SWG:BK" /> where he was intended to give four quests to players.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files and source data}}</ref> However, the third task was bugged as the Gungan Mubarr did not spawn. It was thus impossible to complete Bardo Klinj's questline.<ref name="SWG:BK" /><ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=game_guides&message.id=148427|text=Quests NPC all around SWG World - March 2004}}</ref><ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=jedi&message.id=76216.html|text=Has Anyone Completed All the Working Static Quests?}} {{C|"username/password: swganh"}}</ref> In the non-playable fourth quest, the player would have been tasked to escort a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] named [[Xan'lak]].<ref name="TRE" />
